newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Deere cut to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Deere cut to hold from buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst J. Blair Brumley said Wednesday he cut his rating on equipment manufacturer Deere & Co to a hold from a buy.

-- He also lowered his earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 to $3.45 a share from $3.85. He cut his fiscal 1997 first quarter earnings view to $0.65 a share from $0.70, his second quarter to $1.15 from $1.26, his third quarter to $0.80 from $0.86 and his fourth quarter to $0.85 from $1.03.
-- On November 26, Deere reported earnings for fiscal 1996, ended October 31, of $0.68 a share up from $0.57. Brumley said results were "disappointing" compared with his $0.91 estimate.
-- "Operationally, the big disappointment clearly came in the commercial and consumer equipment segment which essentially broke even during the period," Brumley wrote in a report.
-- A big concern, he added, is Deere's spending in advance of new product introductions and production ramp-ups that will continue during fiscal 1997.
-- Deere's shares were up 3/4 at 44-3/4 at mid-day.
